autonomy_levels.A3: supervised execution after explicit operator approval
autonomy_levels.A5: broader autonomous remediation after evidence-based promotion

notes: This registry is intentionally empty on first introduction. Current L2 workers remain read-only.
A capability must be implemented as a narrow deterministic harness operation before it can be added here.
Autonomy is promoted per capability from shadow to supervised to autonomous based on replay/live evidence; there is no global raw-SQL permission switch.
